title: Graph-free Retrieval with Graph-Modified Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2610.18410v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dense vector retrieval can miss evidence connected through intermediate entities, while direct graph retrieval requires access to the graph at query time. We compare five offline graph-based embedding transformations and strategies for using the resulting graph-modified embeddings alongside the originals, without query-time graph access. On a synthetic professional-network benchmark with complete supporting-evidence sets, direct replacement of the original embeddings reduces evidence recovery. Multi-stage strategies improve recovery by using graph-modified embeddings to guide the search while retaining the originals for semantic relevance. On questions requiring linked facts or comparisons among candidates, the strongest configuration improves recovery by up to 25.9% relative to plain vector retrieval. It also matches baseline recovery with 40% fewer returned nodes. Controls confirm that graph information contributes beyond multi-stage

translated_title: 基于图修改嵌入的无图检索
translated_abstract: 稠密向量检索可能会遗漏通过中间实体关联的证据，而直接的图检索则需要在查询时访问图结构。我们比较了五种离线的基于图的嵌入变换方法，以及在不进行查询时图访问的情况下，将所得到的图修改嵌入与原始嵌入结合使用的多种策略。在一个具有完整支持证据集合的合成职业网络基准上，直接替换原始嵌入会降低证据召回率；而多阶段策略通过使用图修改嵌入来引导搜索、同时保留原始嵌入以保证语义相关性，从而提升证据召回率。在需要关联事实或在候选之间进行比较的问题上，最强的配置相对于普通向量检索可将召回率提升最多25.9%，并且在返回节点减少40%的情况下仍能达到基线的召回水平。对照实验证实，图信息的贡献超越了多阶段检索本身。
tldr: 该论文提出在无需查询时访问图的前提下，利用离线图嵌入变换生成的图修改嵌入并配合多阶段检索策略，在需要关联事实或候选比较的问题上，相比普通向量检索最多提升25.9%的证据召回率，同时返回节点数减少40%。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that offline graph-modified embeddings combined with multi-stage retrieval, without query-time graph access, improve evidence recovery by up to 25.9% over plain vector retrieval on linked-fact and comparison questions while returning 40% fewer nodes.
